Momentary happiness tracked expectations and prediction errors rather than current earnings (Rutledge et al., 2014, PNAS, PMID 25092308). Lottery winners were not happier than controls and took less pleasure in mundane events (Brickman, Coates & Janoff-Bulman, 1978, JPSP, PMID 690806; 22 winners).

alt: A short film with no voice. A sunset coastal city, beautiful, with big game bars on top: HOUR 6, YOU TODAY and YOU YESTERDAY, exactly equal. A card says Graphics: upgraded from the start, then Bar: unchanged. A big black figure with white eyes, no hands and sunglasses pushed up on its forehead stands in the middle, eyes happy, and a card says: Same you. Better sky.
